# Dialer Bot

> AI voice bots that qualify inbound and outbound calls for call centers, truck dispatch, ACA, FE, and HI — then warm-handoff closable leads to human agents.

Dialer Bot is built in Islamabad, Pakistan. Primary conversion paths are the live product demo and WhatsApp sales. Public contact email is Query@dialerbot.online. Job applications go through the careers portal on this site.

## Primary

- [Home](https://dialerbot.online/): Product overview and main sales pitch for Dialer Bot
- [Features](https://dialerbot.online/features): Intent scoring, opener packs, compliance gates, transcripts, routing, pace control
- [Pricing](https://dialerbot.online/pricing): Starter bot pricing and enterprise quote path
- [Live demo](https://demo.dialerbot.online/): Full working Dialer Bot product demo
- [Contact](https://dialerbot.online/contact): WhatsApp, email, office address, and contact form
- [Company](https://dialerbot.online/company): About Contactivity / Dialer Bot team in Islamabad
- [Careers](https://dialerbot.online/careers): Open roles and hiring portal

## Product niches

- [ACA voice bot](https://dialerbot.online/solutions/aca-voice-bot): Compliant ACA / FE / HI qualification and warm handoff
- [Truck dispatch bot](https://dialerbot.online/solutions/truck-dispatch-bot): First logistics questions before dispatchers join
- [Warm handoff](https://dialerbot.online/solutions/warm-handoff): Context-rich transfers instead of cold dumps
- [Features](https://dialerbot.online/features): Intent scoring, opener packs, compliance, vault, routing, pace
